services.name: Tandem Skydiving
services.desc: Have you ever wanted to cross skydiving off your bucket list? If the answer is yes then your in the right place The Stratosphere 12,250 feet (3KM high) is our most popular choice to experience the rush of freefall. The instructor will do all the work, and your job is to have fun! You will be connected to an instructor who will guide you through the entire experience as you both board the aircraft and climb to 12,250 feet above ground level (AGL). Ready, set, GO! You'll exit the aircraft and freefall together for up to 45 seconds, reaching speeds of 200 km/h before your parachute is deployed. Once under the parachute, you'll experience a five-minute panoramic canopy ride down to the ground.
